faq.title: Common questions
faq.description: Below are answers to the questions asked most often about our AI staff and websites.

q1.question: Which businesses is this service for?
q1.answer: The service is built for small and medium businesses that take customer inquiries regularly. Stores, service centers, auto parts shops, and clinics are a typical fit.

q2.question: Is technical knowledge required?
q2.answer: It is not required. We handle configuration and rollout end to end. You edit your content through a simple admin panel.

q3.question: What does the monthly fee cover?
q3.answer: Servers, model usage, monitoring, knowledge updates, and support are covered by the monthly fee. Call minutes for Eho are the only extra charge.

q4.question: Will AI staff replace employees?
q4.answer: They do not. AI staff handle the daily load: repeat questions, bookings, reminders, and reports. Anything sensitive or unusual is passed to your team.

q5.question: What does Ara base its answers on?
q5.answer: Ara answers only from the information you supply: prices, hours, services, and terms. Anything outside that scope is passed to your team rather than guessed.

q6.question: How long does rollout take?
q6.answer: AI staff go live within 3–5 days. A website is delivered within 7–10 working days.
